calls.title: Jeff Ignacio and Roman Kniahynyckyj - UTS
calls.summary: The team discussed the development of a scalable lead assignment process to manage growth and prevent overlap, with a round-robin system in HubSpot on hold until roles for new reps are defined. Jeff is tasked with creating a strategic lead distribution plan that allows new reps to start with lower-tier leads for effective onboarding. Enhancements to sales forecasting and pipeline accuracy were emphasized, with a major data cleanup initiative for renewal deals from 2023-2025. The need for lead scoring and lifecycle frameworks was acknowledged, and a new RevOps Slack channel was proposed to centralize communication and improve coordination. Additionally, the integration and cleanup of data systems, including HubSpot, Apollo, and Rio, were highlighted as critical for seamless lead management.
calls.keywords: RevOps, Lead Scoring, HubSpot Integration, Sales Forecasting, Lead Routing, Sales Cadence
calls.action_items:
**Ashley Stirrup**
Lead the coordination with Jeff and Ryan to define scalable lead/account assignment and routing processes, especially for new rep onboarding (06:26)
Investigate and resolve Slack channel creation permissions; create and add members to a private RevOps Slack channel including Jeff, Roman, Ryan, and Chris Newton (22:50)
Facilitate linking Zoom and HubSpot integration for lead generation events and workflows (09:40)
Clarify Sales Navigator usage internally and gather information on rep access levels (11:00)

**Jeff Ignacio**
Develop detailed lead scoring model based on historical closing data and lead behaviors to inform marketing and sales alignment (19:00)
Continue building out and refining sales forecasting cadence, forecast submission process, and revenue attribution mechanisms including automations (12:30)
Draft sales process stage definitions and MEDDIC qualification framework; validate with Ryan (16:40)
Create estimates/models for sales calls and meetings goals for Ryan’s team (20:20)
Explore Sales Navigator subscriptions and evaluate integration benefits for outbound sales motions (11:00)

**Roman Kniahynyckyj**
Continue managing HubSpot configuration, round robin assignment workflows, and advise on best practices for data integration (05:00)
Provide feedback on Sales Navigator subscription requirements and integration capabilities (11:10)
Share access and manage collaboration within Slack environments, including potentially the external Unlimited channel (25:00)
